label: M37_mode1_v0_designer_2026-05-11
_note: M37 mode 1 small-tune target (Designer fresh-context output, 2026-05-11).
- ge20_lt100 RTP-pp +10pp (16.5 → ~26.5) — DESIGNER VERDICT: STRUCTURALLY INFEASIBLE
Best feasible ceiling = 19.28 RTP-pp (only +2.7pp). Reason: when boosting R2 minor
to lift ge20-100, the mini/minor-alone fallback (no R1+R3 match) lands in ge5_lt10
bucket (5x flat), not ge20-100. To force minor mass into ge20-100 requires high
R1+R3 paying density (= high hit), conflicting with hit 14-16 target.
Independently verified via 4000-sample random lever search; documented in design_v0.md §2.
Spill goes to ge5_lt10 (+15.6pp): mass shifts from low-end small wins to mid-range
BOOSTER-HIER (universal §1 inverse-pyramid mini > minor > major > grand):
VIOLATED — minor (6.40%) > mini (1.14%) — user-accepted per brief 2026-05-11.
MODE7-LOCK — DEPENDS ON USER DECISION (design_v0_questions_for_user.md Q2):
option (a) m7 R2 follows m1 → preserves LOCK, requires m7 weights re-tune
option (b) MODE7-LOCK tolerance loosen ±3x → m1 only commit

_design_constraints.archetype: IGT Triple Diamond chassis + Lightning Link mini/minor/major/grand jackpot tier naming + M37Cfg published baseline reference (UNCHANGED — small tune retains v3 finalized archetype)
_design_constraints.bucket_shape_intent: Mid-tier bell shifted — ge1_5 cut hard, ge5_10 (minor-alone fallback) becomes new peak, ge20-100 lifted modestly. Grand 1000x lifetime tier preserved.
_design_constraints.per_mode_variation_mechanism: per-mode reel weight remapping on shared physical layout (26 stops, alternating B/N) — strip layout unchanged from v3
_design_constraints.booster_hier_per_mode_override: mode 1 only: minor > mini > major > grand allowed (inverse top tier per user brief 2026-05-11). mode 2/5/7 retain universal §1 inverse pyramid mini > minor > major > grand.
_design_constraints.ge20_100_target_status: DIRECTIONAL_INFORMATIONAL — physical ceiling 19.28 RTP-pp documented; not enforced as red line. User to confirm acceptance per design_v0_questions_for_user.md Q1.
_design_constraints.mode7_lock_decision: PENDING_USER — see design_v0_questions_for_user.md Q2 (either m7 weights mirror m1 R2 changes, or MODE7-LOCK tolerance loosened ±3x).

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R1_wild
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R1 wild marginal 1.49% (cut from baseline 1.78%, -16%). Pareto trap anchor: high cost_weight prevents tuner collapsing to 0. Reduces side-wild-alone (pid 9 mult 1x) ge1_5 contribution.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R1_high7
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R1 high7 marginal 16.95% (boost from baseline 14.25%, +19%). R1 winners-friendly per §12. Compensates the R2 high7 cut to preserve jackpot path (high7-grand-high7).

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R1_bar_total
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R1 bar total marginal 36% (cut from baseline 49.5%, -27%). Reduces pid 7 anybar (ge1_5 main contributor) and overall R1 hit density.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R3_wild
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R3 wild marginal 1.50% (mirrors R1, same scaling). Pareto trap anchor.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R3_high7
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R3 high7 marginal 16.03% (boost from baseline 13.49%). Mirrors R1 boost (R3 slightly less to maintain §12 R1 > R3 winners-friendly direction).

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R2_mini
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R2 mini marginal 1.14% (CUT 70% from baseline 3.73%). Eliminates the bulk of pid 9 mult 2x (mini-alone) ge1_5 contribution. HIER inversion accepted per user brief.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R2_minor
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R2 minor marginal 6.40% (BOOST 2.4x from baseline 2.68%). Only 'clean' lever for ge20_lt100 lift (no spill to ge100+ — max minor combo high7×3 × 5 = 50× lands in ge50_lt100). High cost_weight + tight tolerance to keep this lift.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R2_major
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R2 major marginal 1.60% (slight cut from baseline 2.04%, -22%). Major contribution would spill into ge100_lt200 (high7×3 × 10 = 100×), so we trim it slightly to keep ge100-200 from inflating.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R2_grand
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R2 grand marginal 0.092% (slight cut from baseline 0.112%, -18%). Still in GRAND-SIGNATURE [0.05%, 0.15%] band. Jackpot freq remains ~1/34-37k spins (lifetime tier). Tightest tolerance + highest cost_weight — brand-defining anchor.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R2_high7
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R2 high7 marginal 4.81% (CUT 54% from baseline 10.50%). Releases RTP budget for minor boost. high7-grand-high7 jackpot path still satisfied via R1/R3 high7 boost (compensation). Trade-off documented in design_v0.md §8.3 — user-confirm via Q3.

per_reel_symbol_targets.name: R2_bar_total
per_reel_symbol_targets.pattern: R2 bar total ~27% (slight cut from baseline 30.3%, -11%). Maintains mid-pay (R2-bar in 3-bar combos via pid 5/6/7) but doesn't compete with minor for RTP budget.
